scope: Baseline host-file integrity and per-source CMO signal inventory in the full N.brasiliensis-history/later-IAV-challenge study. No gene/tag ranking, thresholds, cell assignment, biological subsetting or contrast.
inference_limit: Nonzero antibody-tag counts do not establish assigned conditions or animal/pool identities. Barcode uniqueness and tag IDs are library-local. Tag totals sum all stored entries; positive barcode counts deduplicate coordinates; maximum is the maximum stored entry, not a per-cell aggregate. Gene Expression entries are not certified unique coordinates.
